SELECT source_type, settle_date, qty, fee, insur_type, insur_type_name FROM (
SELECT '账平' AS source_type, a.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, a.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_biz_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = 1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额-his正交易' AS source_type, b.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(b.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(b.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, b.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b INNER JOIN ips_dz_biz_bills a ON a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.bill_date <= b.bill_date AND a.medfee_sumamt = -b.medfee_sumamt AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.mdtrt_id = b.mdtrt_id AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') WHERE b.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.INSUTYPE = #{insurType} GROUP BY b.insutype, b.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额-医保正交易' AS source_type, b.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(b.setl_id) AS qty, -SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, b.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b INNER JOIN ips_dz_pay_bills a ON a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.setl_id = b.setl_id AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') WHERE b.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.INSUTYPE = #{insurType} GROUP BY b.insutype, b.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保正金额' AS source_type, a.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, a.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date ) ORDER BY settle_date, source_type

SELECT source_type, settle_date, qty, fee, insur_type, insur_type_name FROM (
SELECT '账平' AS source_type, a.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, a.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = 1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额' AS source_type, a.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, a.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保正金额' AS source_type, a.bill_date AS settle_date, COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, a.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date ) ORDER BY settle_date, source_type

SELECT 'HIS业务表' AS table_name, COUNT(t.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(NVL(t.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee FROM ips_dz_biz_bills t WHERE t.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND t.insutype = #{insurType} UNION ALL SELECT '医保支付表' AS table_name, COUNT(t.setl_id) AS qty, SUM(NVL(t.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee FROM ips_dz_pay_bills t WHERE t.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND t.insutype = #{insurType}

SELECT b.setl_id AS setl_id, b.bill_date AS settle_date, b.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name, b.medfee_sumamt AS medfee_sumamt FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b WHERE b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills a WHERE a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.mdtrt_id = b.mdtrt_id AND a.medfee_sumamt = -b.medfee_sumamt AND a.bill_date <= b.bill_date AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.setl_id = b.setl_id AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ) ORDER BY b.setl_id

SELECT diff_side, settle_date, setl_id, insur_type, insur_type_name, pay_zp, pay_zp_name, biz_zp, biz_zp_name, pay_fee, biz_fee, offset_pair, pair_key FROM ( SELECT '仅医保支付表' AS diff_side, p.bill_date AS settle_date, p.setl_id AS setl_id, p.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(p.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name, TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag) AS pay_zp, DECODE(p.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag)) AS pay_zp_name, NULL AS biz_zp, NULL AS biz_zp_name, p.medfee_sumamt AS pay_fee, NULL AS biz_fee,
CASE WHEN p.is_show = 'true' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills r WHERE r.mdtrt_id = p.mdtrt_id AND r.insutype = p.insutype AND r.psn_no = p.psn_no AND r.medfee_sumamt = -p.medfee_sumamt AND r.setl_id != p.setl_id AND r.is_show = 'true' AND ( (p.medfee_sumamt > 0 AND r.bill_date >= p.bill_date) OR (p.medfee_sumamt < 0 AND r.bill_date <= p.bill_date) ) ) THEN '自对冲' END AS offset_pair, p.mdtrt_id AS pair_key FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p WHERE p.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND p.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills b WHERE b.setl_id = p.setl_id) UNION ALL SELECT '仅HIS业务表' AS diff_side, b.bill_date AS settle_date, b.setl_id AS setl_id, b.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name, NULL AS pay_zp, NULL AS pay_zp_name, TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag) AS biz_zp, DECODE(b.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag)) AS biz_zp_name, NULL AS pay_fee, b.medfee_sumamt AS biz_fee, NULL AS offset_pair, NULL AS pair_key FROM ips_dz_biz_bills b WHERE b.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p WHERE p.setl_id = b.setl_id) UNION ALL SELECT '账平标志不一致' AS diff_side, p.bill_date AS settle_date, p.setl_id AS setl_id, p.insutype AS insur_type, DECODE(p.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民') AS insur_type_name, TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag) AS pay_zp, DECODE(p.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag)) AS pay_zp_name, TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag) AS biz_zp, DECODE(b.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag)) AS biz_zp_name, p.medfee_sumamt AS pay_fee, b.medfee_sumamt AS biz_fee, NULL AS offset_pair, NULL AS pair_key FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p INNER JOIN ips_dz_biz_bills b ON b.setl_id = p.setl_id AND b.insutype = p.insutype WHERE p.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND p.insutype = #{insurType} AND b.zp_flag != p.zp_flag ) ORDER BY CASE diff_side WHEN '仅医保支付表' THEN 1 WHEN '仅HIS业务表' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, setl_id
